optional_concepts: even power of a perfect square results in another perfect square
acceptable_paraphrases: does not result in a whole number
critical_errors: stating they are squares or can be squared
ignoring the fact that numbers end with specific digits
misconceptions: thinking all perfect powers result in a whole number
assuming any large number is a perfect square
grading_notes: Focus on the fact that numbers ending with 2 or 8 cannot be squares. Ignore trivial formatting differences, such as ^ and _
